title: A bill to designate the airport traffic control tower located at Piedmont Triad International Airport in Greensboro, North Carolina, as the "Senator Kay Hagan Airport Traffic Control Tower".
official_summary: This bill designates the airport traffic control tower located at Piedmont Triad International Airport in Greensboro, North Carolina, as the Senator Kay Hagan Airport Traffic Control Tower.

summary.headline: A 2020 law renames the air traffic control tower at Piedmont Triad International Airport in Greensboro, North Carolina, after former Senator Kay Hagan.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives the airport traffic control tower at Piedmont Triad International Airport in Greensboro, North Carolina, a new official name: the Senator Kay Hagan Airport Traffic Control Tower. It is a naming measure only and does not change how the tower operates or who runs it.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 30, 2020, and the designation took effect on that date.
